_readme: FIAT CRATES (13 Oct, docs/design/search_crates.md): the eight crates of the search, each shut and open (art/crates/, 64 x 64, shown at 52 on the run screen's crate row). The shut and open of a crate share a seed, and the open one is drawn from the shut PNG (reference + style image), so they read as the same thing. Redo a pair as: ++ --only <key> ++ --force (the shut is written first).

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_crates_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list). A job whose file exists is skipped; one that came out wrong: ++ --only <name> ++ --force.

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a battered brown cardboard box, its flaps folded shut, parcel tape peeling, one corner crushed and water-stained. One object centred and filling the frame, seen from a little above and to the side, a single bold silhouette that still reads at a quarter of this size, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game icon; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette, worn and scuffed, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, a plain dark neutral background.
